items.name: Branch
items.description: A dry branch, light and brittle. Kindling and the start of every build.

items.name: Log
items.description: A section of trunk. Heavy; you need an axe to get one.

items.name: Hardwood
items.description: Dense old-oak heartwood. Takes an edge and a polish.

items.name: Bark
items.description: Peeled bark, curled at the edges. Good tinder; some kinds steep into tea.

items.name: Plant fibre
items.description: Stringy fibres stripped from tall grass and reeds.

items.name: Vine
items.description: A tough green vine, still supple.

items.name: Plant resin
items.description: Amber beads of resin wept from a wounded pine. Sticky, fragrant.

items.name: Feather
items.description: A grey-brown flight feather, barbs still neat.

items.name: Shed antler
items.description: A shed antler, gnawed at the tip by something small.

items.name: Empty eggshell
items.description: Half a speckled shell, long hatched.

items.name: Stone
items.description: A fist-sized stone. The forest has no shortage.

items.name: Flint
items.description: Dark glassy flint. Strike it and it sparks.

items.name: Clay
items.description: Cool grey clay from the pond bank. Keeps the shape you press into it.

items.name: Coal
items.description: A lump of coal. Burns long and hot.

items.name: Copper ore
items.description: Green-flecked rock with a dull metallic sheen.

items.name: Iron ore
items.description: Rust-red, heavy for its size.

items.name: Quartz
items.description: A cloudy white crystal, cold to the touch.

items.name: Amethyst
items.description: Violet crystal points clustered on grey rock.

items.name: Moonstone
items.description: Milky stone with a blue sheen that only shows under moonlight.

items.name: Geode
items.description: A dull round stone. Heavier than it should be; something hollow inside.

items.name: Meadow daisy
items.description: White petals, yellow heart. Grows wherever the sun reaches.

items.name: Bellflower
items.description: Nodding blue bells on a thin stem.

items.name: Field poppy
items.description: Crimson petals that bruise if you hold them too long.

items.name: Yarrow
items.description: Feathery leaves and flat white heads. Stops bleeding, the old books say.

items.name: Wild mint
items.description: Square stems, cool smell. Grows where the ground stays damp.

items.name: Rowan berries
items.description: Bitter orange-red berries in heavy clusters.

items.name: Blackberry
items.description: Sweet, staining, guarded by thorns.

items.name: Burdock root
items.description: A long tap root, earthy and filling once boiled.

items.name: Brown cap
items.description: A plain brown mushroom. Safe, nutty, everywhere after rain.

items.name: Scarlet cap
items.description: Red cap, white flecks. Beautiful, and not for eating.

items.name: Moss
items.description: A soft green pad of moss, damp underneath.

items.name: Wild seeds
items.description: A pinch of mixed meadow seed.

items.name: Fern frond
items.description: A young curled frond.

items.name: Night lily
items.description: A pale lily that opens only after dark, on still water.

items.name: Metal scrap
items.description: A bent strip of old steel, orange with rust.

items.name: Rusted gear
items.description: A toothed wheel from some machine. Still turns, grudgingly.

items.name: Copper wire
items.description: A tangle of green-tarnished wire.

items.name: Broken circuit board
items.description: Cracked green board, components still soldered on.

items.name: Old battery
items.description: A cylinder with a faded label. Might hold a little charge.

items.name: Glass fragment
items.description: Sea-green glass, edges worn smooth by years of rain.

items.name: Bolt and nut
items.description: Still threaded together after all this time.

items.name: Faded photograph
items.description: Two people on a dock, squinting at the sun. The pond behind them looks the same.

items.name: Brass key
items.description: A small brass key on a loop of cord. Nothing here has a lock. Yet.

items.name: Tin cup
items.description: Dented, but it holds water.

items.name: Moondew
items.description: A luminous liquid that beads on glow-cap gills after dark. Fades by morning unless bottled.

items.name: Ghostcap
items.description: A translucent mushroom that rises only in damp woods after midnight and is gone by dawn.
items.habitat: damp forest floor, after midnight, after rain

items.name: Starshard
items.description: A splinter of black mineral full of pinprick lights. Cold even in the sun.
items.habitat: thin rock that only shows under a clear moon

items.name: Emberroot
items.description: A knotted root that stays warm in the hand. Grows where the ground is heated from below.
items.habitat: warm vents near the ruin, after dark

items.name: Lantern moth
items.description: A large pale moth drawn to lantern light. Its wing dust glows faintly.

items.name: Heartwood seed
items.description: A single seed from the oldest oak, found once in a lifetime among its roots. Plant it, and wait.
items.habitat: roots of the great oak, one autumn night after rain

items.name: Plank
items.description: A split board, still smelling of the tree.

items.name: Cord
items.description: Plant fibre twisted until it holds.

items.name: Nails
items.description: Cut from old scrap and hammered straight.

items.name: Stone block
items.description: Squared on four faces, near enough.

items.name: Iron ingot
items.description: Rough, dark and honest.

items.name: Copper ingot
items.description: Soft, warm-coloured, and easy to work cold.

items.name: Glass pane
items.description: Old glass melted and poured flat. A little wavy.

items.name: Hinge
items.description: Two leaves and a pin. It makes a door a door.

items.name: Woven cloth
items.description: Coarse, warm, and yours.

items.name: Crate
items.description: Rough slats lashed tight. Holds what you cannot carry.

items.name: Workbench
items.description: A plank top, a vise, and the first real tool you own.

items.name: Stoneworking block
items.description: A low boulder dressed flat, for squaring stone.

items.name: Sawhorses
items.description: Two trestles and a saw: boards come cleaner here.

items.name: Smelting furnace
items.description: A stone dome and a hot mouth. Ore goes in, metal comes out.

items.name: Advanced workbench
items.description: Salvaged drawers, a working gear train, and a lamp that still glows.

items.name: Chest
items.description: Iron-strapped, with a lock that mostly works.

items.name: Large chest
items.description: For a household, not a camp.

items.name: Moss-stuffed bed
items.description: A real frame and a soft mattress of dried moss.

items.name: Cottage bed
items.description: A quilt, at last.

items.name: Rustic table
items.description: Planks and pegs.

items.name: Stone-top table
items.description: Cold in the morning, solid forever.

items.name: Salvage table
items.description: A steel frame with a weathered top.

items.name: Cottage table
items.description: A cloth makes it a home.

items.name: Ladderback chair
items.description: Honest and slightly crooked.

items.name: Cushioned chair
items.description: A little blue cushion.

items.name: Shelves
items.description: A place for jars and small finds.

items.name: Bookshelf
items.description: For what you write down and what you rescue.

items.name: Cabinet
items.description: Two panelled doors on proper hinges.

items.name: Woven rug
items.description: Red and gold, dyed with poppies.

items.name: Moss-green rug
items.description: Quiet colours from the woods.

items.name: Floor lamp
items.description: Warm light behind a cloth shade.

items.name: Small lantern
items.description: A little flame in old glass.

items.name: Potted fern
items.description: A piece of the forest indoors.

items.name: Painted landscape
items.description: Your clearing, more or less.

items.name: Wall shelf
items.description: Hangs on a wall face.

items.name: Cookstove
items.description: Stone body, iron flue. Cooking comes later; the warmth is now.

items.name: Kitchen counter
items.description: Stone top on a wooden base.

items.name: Spore jar
items.description: Cold light that never needs oil. Stalkers do not mind it, but you might.

items.name: Raised garden bed
items.description: Ready for planting when seeds can be sown.

items.name: Luminous spores
items.description: Soft pale dust that keeps its glow for days. Shaken loose, never taken by force.

items.name: Nightglass
items.description: Black glass that grows on the pond bank after midnight. By day it looks like wet stone.

items.name: Rot fibre
items.description: Pale threads from a Wanderer. Stronger than they look; they still twitch a little.

items.name: Stalker lens
items.description: A hard clear bead from one of its three eyes. Things look closer through it.

items.name: Burrower ring
items.description: A flexible ringed plate from the grub, like horn and leather at once.

items.name: Throat sac
items.description: Empty now. It still hums when the wind crosses it.

items.name: Stoneplate
items.description: Living rock from a Brute shoulder, moss still growing on it.

items.name: Moondew tonic
items.description: Mint steeped in moondew. Restores a good deal of health.

items.name: Ghostcap salve
items.description: Cold on the skin, then nothing hurts for a while. Restores all health.

items.name: Basic wooden rod
items.description: A straight ash pole with a proper tip ring. Better control than the reed.

items.name: Improved rod
items.description: Jointed, with wire guides. It bends where it should.

items.name: Reinforced rod
items.description: Iron-sleeved at the butt. It will not be the first thing to give.

items.name: Specialist rod
items.description: Resin-laid strips and a moonstone tip guide. For the fish in the stories.

items.name: Braided line
items.description: Three cords laid as one. Survives a strong run.

items.name: Wire trace
items.description: Fine wire above the hook. Teeth do not bother it.

items.name: Iron hook
items.description: Holds better in a soft mouth.

items.name: Barbed hook
items.description: Once in, it stays in. A slack line will not lose the fish so easily.

items.name: Quill float
items.description: Feather-light. Gives you longer to answer a bite.

items.name: Worms
items.description: Fat and unwilling. Almost everything eats them.

items.name: Insects
items.description: A pinch of wings and legs from the reeds.

items.name: Baitfish
items.description: A small fish on a big hook, for predators.

items.name: Plant dough
items.description: Seed meal and mushroom, kneaded. Carp cannot resist it.

items.name: Night bait
items.description: Worm rolled in moondew. It shines faintly, and strange things come to it.

items.name: Spinner lure
items.description: A flashing blade. Predators and bad weather love it. Not eaten, but a snapped line loses it.

items.name: Tied fly
items.description: Feather and thread. Delicate fish take it on clear days.

items.name: Moth lure
items.description: Wings of dust and a real moth body, for the things that rise at night.

items.name: Glow lure
items.description: Spores set in nightglass. It is the only thing some fish have ever looked at.

items.name: Minnow
items.description: Hardly a mouthful, and always in company. Where these flicker, larger things are watching.

items.name: Perch
items.description: Banded like shade under reeds, with fins the colour of a warning.

items.name: Roach
items.description: A steady silver fish with a red-rimmed eye. Most anglers start here and some never leave.

items.name: Rudd
items.description: Brass flanks and scarlet fins. It looks up for its dinner, so you see the swirl before the fish.

items.name: Gudgeon
items.description: A speckled bottom-grubber with one small whisker. It will bite anything, and looks surprised after.

items.name: Bleak
items.description: Narrow as a blade and just as bright. Shoals scatter at a shadow.

items.name: Ruffe
items.description: A rough little perch-cousin with a saw for a back and a blue-ringed eye.

items.name: Bitterling
items.description: The smallest jewel in the pond: rose flanks and one aqua stroke.

items.name: Common carp
items.description: An olive-gold grazer. Slow to take and in no hurry to leave.

items.name: Whiskered catfish
items.description: Flat-headed and mottled, with long whiskers for a night that it cannot see through.

items.name: Jewel sunfish
items.description: Orange, teal and lemon, as if the pond had been saving up. It will charge your float.

items.name: Pumpkinseed
items.description: Blue-scribbled cheeks and a belly like an autumn gourd.

items.name: Tench
items.description: Thick, dark and slippery, with a tiny red eye and rounded paddles for fins.

items.name: Bronze bream
items.description: A tall bronze plate of a fish that comes up like a wet doormat.

items.name: Silver bream
items.description: Smaller, brighter, warier than its bronze cousin, with an eye too large for its head.

items.name: Crucian carp
items.description: A round, buttery fish with a thumbprint at the tail. Its bite is a rumour.

items.name: Mirror carp
items.description: A deep, humped body with a few huge scales like old coins set in leather.

items.name: Pike
items.description: A long-jawed green ambush, freckled in gold. It looks like it has already decided.

items.name: Weather loach
items.description: Country folk keep one in a jar. It thrashes before rain, and it has never yet been wrong.

items.name: Lily darter
items.description: Barely a finger long, barred in moss and lemon, with a cobalt sail for courting.

items.name: Moth gar
items.description: Long-beaked and armoured, with moth-eye marks along the flank. It strikes at wings on the water.

items.name: Golden carp
items.description: A carp entirely the colour of late sun. Nobody has seen one young.

items.name: Albino catfish
items.description: The same fish as the whiskered cat, minus every trace of night. It should not last a week, and yet.

items.name: Old Scarjaw pike
items.description: Barred, black-backed, older than the dock. Its jaw has healed around at least two hooks.

items.name: Ghost koi
items.description: Almost see-through in the lamplight, flowing fins trailing mist. It leaves no wake at all.

items.name: Moonfin
items.description: Sickle fins that glow from their edges inward, and a blue eye-shape on each flank, always looking up.

items.name: Brook trout
items.description: Worm-tracked and flecked red and gold, with white-edged fins bright as a thumbnail.

items.name: River minnow
items.description: Barred and red-bellied in spring, it hangs in current like a leaf that has changed its mind.

items.name: Dace
items.description: Small, silver and punctual: it dimples the same patch of water all afternoon.

items.name: Chub
items.description: Big-headed and broad-mouthed, with black-edged scales. Bolder than it is clever.

items.name: Stone loach
items.description: A mottled pencil of a fish that lives under rocks, and resents being asked.

items.name: Bullhead
items.description: All head and fan-fins, sitting on gravel like a small angry frog.

items.name: Spined loach
items.description: Sandy and row-spotted, with a tiny folding spine beneath its eye.

items.name: Bluestone chubling
items.description: Slate-blue with aqua flecks: the colour of the wet stones it lives between.

items.name: Brown trout
items.description: Butter and umber with haloed spots, as handsome as a fish gets without trying.

items.name: Rainbow trout
items.description: Rose-striped and peppered. Strikes, leaps, reconsiders, leaps again.

items.name: Salmon parr
items.description: A young fish on its way to somewhere enormous, with a row of dark thumbprints along its side.

items.name: Barbel
items.description: Copper-finned, shovel-snouted and built to hold its place in a flood. It fights the same way.

items.name: Riffle darter
items.description: An orange and cobalt scrap that rests on stones with its elbows out.

items.name: Brook lamprey
items.description: An ancient, jawless thread with seven gill-holes and no opinions. Older than bones.

items.name: Grayling
items.description: A silver fish carrying an enormous violet sail, edged crimson. The lady of the stream.

items.name: Kingfisher shiner
items.description: Cobalt above and orange below, with a little beak. It feeds as the bird does, by dropping in.

items.name: Fallen leaf
items.description: A leaf with a midrib, veins, a stem and an appetite. It drifts sideways toward minnows.

items.name: Ember trout
items.description: Black and crimson with spots like a fanned coal. The water near it is a little warmer.

items.name: Moss eel
items.description: Green as the water it lives in. Its one straight line is the one you pull it in on.

items.name: Mudfish
items.description: Brown, blunt and patient. Dries out for months, and wakes up cross.

items.name: Peat perch
items.description: Stained the colour of bog tea, with spines to match. Bites first.

items.name: Fen stickleback
items.description: Thumb-sized, red-breasted and three-spined. Picks fights with fish a hundred times its size.

items.name: Pygmy blackspot
items.description: The smallest fish in the book. Its whole ambition is one black spot on its tail.

items.name: Reed pipefish
items.description: A jointed yellow straw with a tiny mouth at one end, swaying when the reeds sway.

items.name: Marsh catfish
items.description: Black and striped, with a skull like a helmet. It breathes air and walks when it has to.

items.name: Bowfin
items.description: A living fossil with one long wave of a dorsal fin and a false eye at the tail.

items.name: Needle gar
items.description: Thin as a walking stick with a beak like tweezers. Armour instead of scales.

items.name: Lungfish
items.description: Long whip fins like two forgotten legs. Breathes, and sleeps out droughts inside the ground.

items.name: Shellback mudfish
items.description: A small armoured loaf, all overlapping plates and a low, offended stare.

items.name: Reed mudskipper
items.description: Walks on its elbows, eyes on the top of its head, flying a blue sail to anyone who looks.

items.name: Marsh frogmouth
items.description: A warty green purse with a door in it. Waits so long that weed grows on it.

items.name: Ribbon eel
items.description: A knotted thread of violet with bright aqua rings. Always seems to be untying itself.

items.name: Rare marsh eel
items.description: Char-black with gold flecks, thicker than the moss eel. Bites like a closing door.

items.name: Bogwisp
items.description: Glowing green glass with a tail like a whip. Old stories say it leads you away. It does.

items.name: Smelt
items.description: Slim and clear with a bright side stripe. Cold water makes it silver and sweet.

items.name: Vendace
items.description: A pale aqua-backed whitefish of deep cold lakes, once a whole village's winter food.

items.name: Lake trout
items.description: Pale spots on grey like snow on rock. It sounds deep and stays there.

items.name: Alpine sculpin
items.description: A spiny-headed grey lump with big fan fins, sitting on the lake floor like it paid for it.

items.name: Arctic char
items.description: A blue-grey back, a belly like a winter sunset, and white-edged fins.

items.name: Frost perch
items.description: Pale aqua, frost-speckled, with white-tipped spines. It feels cold even for a fish.

items.name: Burbot
items.description: Marbled like old cheese, with a single chin barbel and an eel's long tail.

items.name: Steelhead
items.description: A rainbow trout that has seen the ocean and is unimpressed by you.

items.name: Red kokanee
items.description: Crimson with a green head and a hooked jaw, dying on purpose and beautifully.

items.name: Paddlefish
items.description: A shark's body with a canoe paddle on its nose. It filters water with its mouth wide open.

items.name: Silver ghost char
items.description: Thin-skinned and moon-pale, with long trailing fins. You can almost count its ribs.

items.name: Lake sturgeon
items.description: Rows of bony shields and a shovel nose. Older than the ruin, in family and quite possibly in person.

items.name: Abyss lurker
items.description: All mouth and shadow, with needle teeth and one green lamp on a stalk. Comes up slowly.

items.name: Starry trout
items.description: An indigo night sky in the shape of a trout. The stars on it are not any you can name.

items.name: Deepwater Warden
items.description: An armoured giant, plated like a door, bearded with cold whiskers, with one ember for an eye.

items.name: Blind cavefish
items.description: Flesh-pink, eyeless, unbothered. It feels the world along a line of tiny pits.

items.name: Cave loach
items.description: A bone-coloured line of fish with whiskers doing the work of everything else.

items.name: Rust carp
items.description: Rivet-spotted and pitted, coloured exactly like the pipes it grazes on.

items.name: Drain eel
items.description: Black, ringed in steel-grey and curled like the pipe it lives in.

items.name: Tallow catfish
items.description: Wax-yellow and blind, soft as candle fat. Workers once fed them for the lamp oil.

items.name: Echo fish
items.description: Grey, with ripple rings across its side, like something you dropped in the water a long time ago.

items.name: Coin carp
items.description: Stamped all over in dark rings like old money, and as heavy as it looks.

items.name: Pale olm
items.description: Pink gills like a flower, tiny legs, no eyes to speak of. An amphibian that never agreed to grow up.

items.name: Ink lamprey
items.description: A dripping ink-black loop with a line of faint gill-lights and one pale eye.

items.name: Lantern tetra
items.description: An indigo fish with a row of cyan lamps. A shoal looks like a small town seen from far off.

items.name: Spore gourami
items.description: Fungus-green, glowing in patches, with one long feeler it holds out like a candle.

items.name: Silt ray
items.description: A flat disc of silt with spots for stars and a whip for a tail. Never a fish you notice first.

items.name: Glassscale
items.description: A body like poured glass, with spine, ribs and a small ember of a heart all on show.

items.name: The Hollow Serpent
items.description: A coiled thing all black, with bone showing in rungs through its back and a thin cold light running down the middle.

items.name: Blossom dace
items.description: A dace with petal-pink fins that rises to the blossom falling on the pond, and only then.

items.name: Glowfin
items.description: A slim dark fish whose fins carry a row of soft green lights, blinking in time with the fireflies above.

items.name: Tide lantern
items.description: A fish with a lamp of its own, drifting between the drowned windows as if it still had somewhere to be.

items.name: Hush eel
items.description: A pale eel that lives in the drowned streets and makes no ripple at all, even when caught.

items.name: Dawnbell
items.description: A white bell-flower that opens only on the Awakening. It rings once when it is picked, and never again.

items.name: Pressed rowan blossom
items.description: A blossom from the lone rowan, pressed flat between the pages of your book. One for each year you hang a wish.

items.name: Jar of fireflies
items.description: A glass jar of borrowed light from the Firefly Evening. Let them go when you are ready.

items.name: Moon lily
items.description: A white lily that opens for one night of summer and smells of rain on warm stone.

items.name: Brass compass
items.description: Turned up in the autumn leaves. It points at the ruin, not north. It always has.

items.name: Unsent letter
items.description: "If you find the pond still there, it is because we left it alone." The rest has run in the rain.

items.name: Tin bird
items.description: A wind-up bird from the leaf heaps with exactly one chirp left in it. You have not used it yet.

items.name: Ember cap
items.description: A mushroom from the autumn ring, warm in the hand, glowing faintly orange underneath.

items.name: Drowned bell
items.description: A small brass bell from under the Silent Tide. It does not ring in air. In water, faintly, it does.

items.name: Frost glass
items.description: A shard of the ice lantern you lit on the Silent Tide. It has not melted. It is not going to.

items.name: Carved wooden fish
items.description: A child's carving, smoothed by forty years of pond water. Someone loved it very much.
